summary: SiteOpportunity manages records of opportunities at a site, including their headings, descriptions (with multilingual support), responses, sort order, and whether they are associated with a web page. The module provides CRUD operations, input validation, formatting, and tracks header changes for grouped entries.
purpose: To store, retrieve, update, and delete specific site opportunities, typically categorized under a heading, with descriptions and responses. It provides formatted information for display, ensures data integrity, and integrates with UI elements for numbering and language localization.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the site associated with the opportunity.

fields.name: Response
fields.description: Opportunity response entered by the user.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Sort order for display; -1 means blank.

fields.name: DescriptionFormatted
fields.description: Returns description or DescriptionAlt based on session language.

fields.name: SortOrderFormatted
fields.description: Formatted sort order for display; blank if sort order is -1.

fields.name: WebPage
fields.description: Indicates if this entry is a web page opportunity.

fields.name: HeaderChanged
fields.description: Tracks if the header category has changed for grouped listings.

fields.name: ResponseFormatted
fields.description: Returns formatted response (HTML new lines translation).

workflows.name: Add SiteOpportunity
steps: Validate Response field is not blank
Add parameters: SiteID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder

workflows.name: Update SiteOpportunity
steps: Validate Response field is not blank
Add parameters: SiteOpportunitiesID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder

business_rules: SortOrder value '-1' means blank and is formatted as an empty string
DescriptionAlt is used when alternative language fields are enabled
HeaderChanged flag is true when HeadingID changes between entries
validations: IsValid method checks that Response is not blank
ID must not be zero for update and delete operations
calculations: SortOrderFormatted is calculated as blank if SortOrder is -1, otherwise as the string value of SortOrder
ResponseFormatted translates new lines to HTML
conditions: If session uses alternative language fields, DescriptionFormatted uses DescriptionAlt
WebPage flag set if Description matches WEB_PAGE constant
system_behavior: Provides CRUD operations for site opportunities
Tracks header changes for grouped listings
dependencies: Database procedures: SiteOpportunitiesAdd, SiteOpportunitiesUpdate, SiteOpportunitiesDelete, SiteOpportunitiesSearch, SiteOpportunitiesSearchID
exceptions: Response blank triggers error message and prevents add/update
content_gaps: No detailed error handling or user interface interaction provided
Exact schema for database procedures not included
